message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering the 24-hour window ending 2026-06-25 05:10 IST. One confirmed new relevant vulnerability set was found for a monitored product: Google Chrome. Nearby Cisco and Fortinet items were reviewed but were not counted as confirmed matches because the affected products did not match the monitored Cisco Nexus/UCS/Fabric Extender or Fortigate/FortiOS scope, or the primary vendor publication was older than the current window.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: Chrome Stable security update for CVE-2026-13021 through CVE-2026-13038, including CVE-2026-13028, CVE-2026-13032, CVE-2026-13033, and CVE-2026-13038
- Severity: Critical for four highlighted CVEs; High for the remaining highlighted CVEs, as stated by the Chrome release notes
- Description: Google released Chrome 149.0.7827.196/197 for desktop with 18 security fixes. The highlighted issues include critical use-after-free and out-of-bounds read issues in WebGL, Blink/InterestGroups, and Autofill, plus multiple high-severity memory-safety and validation issues across Chrome components.
- Relevance: Google Chrome is in the monitored product list, and Google’s Chrome Releases post is a first-party advisory for the affected browser.
- Source: Google Chrome Releases, Stable Channel Update for Desktop, June 23, 2026: https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/06/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_0482630350.html

**Possible Matches Needing Review**

- Fortinet FortiSandbox: OpenCVE showed June 24 activity for CVE-2026-39808, CVE-2026-25089, and CVE-2026-39813, but Fortinet’s own PSIRT pages show the primary FortiSandbox advisories were published earlier, and the monitored Fortinet item is Fortigate/FortiOS rather than FortiSandbox. This was not counted as a confirmed in-scope new finding. Sources: Fortinet PSIRT FG-IR-26-112: https://fortiguard.fortinet.com/psirt/FG-IR-26-112; OpenCVE Fortinet listing: https://app.opencve.io/cve/?vendor=fortinet
- Cisco Unified Communications Manager: Cisco’s advisory for CVE-2026-20230 is critical, but Cisco lists the affected products as Unified CM and Unified CM SME. The monitored Cisco products are Cisco Nexus, Cisco UCS, and Cisco Fabric Extender, so this was excluded as a product mismatch. Source: Cisco advisory: https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/csa/cisco-sa-cucm-ssrf-cXPnHcW.html

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for Chrome fleets because the confirmed finding includes multiple critical browser vulnerabilities. No other high-confidence, newly reported vulnerabilities were confirmed for the monitored products in this 24-hour window.
